name: TextBox
description: Single-line text input with optional label, helper text, and validation error display.

props.name: label
props.description: Field label rendered above the input

props.name: error
props.description: Validation error message displayed below the input

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text rendered below the input

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the string value on every change

snippets.webcomponent:
<cl-textbox label="Name" placeholder="Enter your name"></cl-textbox>

<script>
  document.querySelector('cl-textbox').addEventListener('change', (e) => {
    console.log('value:', e.detail);
  });
</script>
